registers.name: Grid Load Power (Low Register)
registers.description:
Represents only grid load,
excluding Backup load; for
three-phase systems, represents the
total active power sum of all grid
phase loads.
Description:
(1) When the actual grid exceeds 65
kW, it combines with register 34343
to form a U32 data type
representing the grid load power.
Combination example:
Power = 700,000 W; 700,000 (Dec)
= 0x00011170 (Hex); therefore,
register 34343 data is 0x0001, and
register 33147 data is 0x1170.
registers.description_v32:
1<-->1W
Only for loads on grid port, not include backup loads
For a three-phase system, it represents the sum of the active
power of each phase load on the grid side.

registers.name: Backup Load Power (Low Register)
registers.description:
A positive value indicates power
flowing out of the energy storage
inverter Backup port, and a negative
value indicates power flowing into
the energy storage inverter Backup
port.
Description:
(1) For models with a capacity not
exceeding 20 kW, use only register
33148.
(2) For models exceeding 20 kW,
combine with register 34344 to
form an S32 data type representing
the Backup load power. See the
combination examples below for
details.
(3) In parallel systems, the master
controller reads the Backup port
active power values from each
inverter and sums them.
Combination examples:
1. Power = 700,000 W; 700,000
(Dec) = 0x00011170 (Hex);
thus, register 34344 data is
0x0001, and register 33148 data
is 0x1170.
2. Power = -1,000 W; -1,000
(Dec) = 0xFFFCFC18 (Hex);
thus, register 34344 data is
0xFFF, and register 33148 data
is 0xFC18.

Convert and write the register in 16-bit ASCII, for example:

following registers respectively. The specific parameters are
as follows:
43794 = ‘0x3031’
43795 = ‘0x3233’
43796 = ‘0x3435’
43797 = ‘0x3637’
43798 = ‘0x3839’
43799 = ‘0x3031’
43800 = ‘0x3233’
43801 = ‘0x3435’
43794 is the highest bit and 43801 is the lowest bit.

registers.name: PCS Limiting Mode Setting
registers.description:
PCS Anti-Reverse-Flow Limiting
Mode Settings:
0: No limit mode (no restriction on
energy exchange between battery
and grid).
1: Output limit mode (only battery
discharge to the grid is allowed;
battery charging from the grid is
prohibited).
2: Input limit mode (only battery
charging from the grid is allowed;
battery discharge to the grid is
prohibited).
3: No-exchange mode (battery
charging from the grid is
prohibited, and battery discharge to
the grid is also prohibited).
Settings are retained after power
loss. Currently only supported for
S6 single-phase high-voltage
energy storage systems.

registers.name: Grid-Side Load Single-Phase Protection Current Limit
registers.description:
When the current of the load
connected to the distribution panel
exceeds the protection limit of the
distribution panel, the inverter
switches to off-grid operation. At
this point, the overload protection
device activates to ensure the
distribution panel current does not
exceed the user-defined limit. This
function becomes effective after the
PCS limiting mode is enabled (i.e.,
when register 43860 is not 0) and
operates under the condition that
protection in register 43871 is
enabled.
Settings are retained after power
loss. Currently only supported for
S6 single-phase high-voltage
energy storage systems.
registers.description_v32:
1<-->1A
117
When the load current connected to the switchboard exceeds
the switchboard protection limit, the inverter switches to
off-grid operation; at this time, the overload protection
device operates to protect the switchboard current from
exceeding the user limit. This function works when 43871
protection is turned on;
Save after power off after setting; currently only supports S6
single-phase high-voltage energy storage;

registers.name: BMS battery real-time SOC
Inverter light board operating indicator status setting
AFCI module characteristic data group number and frame number setting
registers.description:
Low byte: characteristic data group number
Range 1~10; 1 indicates the first group of data, and so on;
High byte: characteristic data group frame number
Range 1~80; 1 indicates the first frame of data in this group,
and so on;
Only for models that support AFCI modules
Data description: The inverter internally stores 10 groups of
AFCI characteristic data, each group has 80 frames of data,
each frame has 64 point data, and each point data occupies 2
bytes
Instructions: The host computer reads the AFCI module
characteristic data process
1. Read the 34407~34408 registers through the 04 function
code to obtain the number of fault data groups and frames
If the function is valid and the group number value is not 0,
proceed to the next step
2. Set the module number and module frame number of the
43868 register through the 06 function code
The host computer reads the characteristic data of groups
1~10 in sequence
For each group of characteristic data, read 1~80 frames of
data in sequence
3. Read the 33409 register through the 04 function code and
wait for the reading progress to be 100%
Each time the host computer sets the group number to be
read and its corresponding frame number, it needs to query
the data preparation before reading the corresponding special
data.
4. Read the fault characteristic data through the 04 function
code (33343~33406)

registers.name: Remote Dispatch Mode Switch
registers.description:
0: Off, 1: On, default 0, other
values invalid.
Description:
This function takes effect when
register 34502 = 0xAA55; specific
function mapping corresponds to
34503.
Registers 44100–44199 are used to
configure the remote dispatch
mode.
All setting values related to the
remote dispatch mode are not
retained after power loss.
Recommendation: The host
computer should write to the
inverter in three parts:
44100–44104 represent the overall
remote dispatch settings.
44105–44115 represent remote
dispatch real-time control.
44116–44199 represent remote
dispatch time-scheduled control
(send no more than 50 registers at a
time:
Periods 1–3 (42 registers) in one
write, periods 4–6 (42 registers) in
one write).
registers.description_v32:
0: OFF
1: ON
Default :OFF, others invalid
1. When 34502 = 0xAA55, indicating the hybrid inverter’s
firmware supports remote dispatch registers:
44100-44199. 34503 indicates the version change of
the remote dispatch registers
2. 44100~44199 is used to set the remote dispatch
function
3. All the remote dispatch registers will not be saved after
power cycle the device
4. The upper computer needs to writes to the inverter in
three command blocks.
4.1: 44100~44104 indicates the system setting of remote
dispatch
4.2: 44105~44115 means remote dispatch real-time
control,
4.3: 44116~44199 indicates remote dispatch TOU control
Note: (For each command, send no more than 50
registers, There are 42 registers in time period 1~3, and
42 registers in time period 4~6)
5. For register 44103 and 44104, write 0xFFFF to reset
the value to default

power value has no effect.
(2) When the control mode is 2:

battery discharge power, positive
values indicate battery charging
power.
Range: –(maximum
charge/discharge power × number
of parallel units) ~ +(maximum
charge/discharge power × number
of parallel units).

Import power, positive values
indicate Export power.
Range: –(inverter maximum
output power × number of parallel
units) ~ +(inverter maximum output
power × number of parallel units).
(4) When the control mode is 4:
Negative values indicate
Import power, positive values
indicate Export power.
Range: –(inverter maximum
output power × number of parallel
units) ~ +(inverter maximum output
power × number of parallel units).
